personalInfo.title: Senior Software Engineer
personalInfo.bio: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of hands-on experience architecting and delivering scalable cloud-native backends, data integration pipelines, microservices, and high-availability enterprise systems. Expertise in .NET Core, Node.js, AWS & Azure cloud services, ETL processes, and AI integrations for real-time applications. Proven in optimizing performance, reducing latency, and building platforms for billing, appointments, and AI-driven interpretation (live speech-to-text, human-in-the-loop workflows). Adept at translating complex business requirements into robust, production-ready solutions while mentoring teams and ensuring reliability at scale.
